RU485200433.abstract: FIELD: plastic and maxillofacial surgery. SUBSTANCE: lateral and incomplete medial oblique osteotomies is performed with preservation of intact bone bridges between the lines of lateral and medial oblique osteotomies, and ultrasound rhinosculpture of the bone pyramid. Through incisions in the perichondrium on both sides at the caudal edge of the septum, the nasal septum is separated subperichondrially along its entire length. Next, the upper lateral cartilages are separated from the nasal septum from the W-zone to the key zone while preserving the horizontal component of the upper lateral cartilage. Then the nasal septum is lowered by the planned value and a cartilage graft is taken while maintaining an L-shaped frame at least 10 mm wide. Cartilaginous expansion grafts 15–20 mm long and 1.5–2 mm thick are fixed to the septum on each side. Additionally, expanding flaps of the upper lateral cartilages (split spreader flap) are formed and fixed with longitudinal notches and turning inward to create duplication and a springy effect. Using a conical milling cutter attachment from a piezo device, two holes are formed in the caudal part of the bone pyramid on each side in the projection of the lateral key zone at a distance of 3–4 mm from each other. After this, using a PDS 5/0 thread, two interrupted sutures or one Z-shaped suture are placed through the indicated holes between the caudal edge of the bony slope and the cranial edge of the upper lateral cartilage. Additionally, the external valve is strengthened with a short lath graft under the lateral crus of the lower lateral cartilage. Next, the terminal section of the nose is formed according to anatomical landmarks. The skin-muscle flap is placed back in place. The aesthetic result is visually assessed and sutured with PDS 6/0 thread using simple interrupted sutures. Air-conducting intranasal splints are inserted into the nasal cavity and fixed with one interrupted suture; they are removed on an outpatient basis on the seventh day. A strip bandage is applied to the nose and an external thermoplastic nasal splint is fixed in place, which is removed on an outpatient basis on the 14th day. The closing member is movable between a closed position on the valve seat sealing a material outlet, and an open position raised above the valve seat leaving the outlet clear. An actuating element rigidly connected to the closing member is arranged between first and second piezo-actuators at a distance from the first piezo-actuator in the closed position less than the maximum length change of the first piezo-actuator, or lies loosely thereon and at a distance from the second piezo-actuator longer than the maximum length change of the first piezo-actuator. KR314546651.title: FLUID CONTROL VALVE, FLOW RATE CONTROL DEVICE AND DRIVING CIRCUIT
KR314546651.abstract: Provided is a fluid control valve capable of suppressing heat generated during contraction by discharging electric charges from a piezo actuator, and reducing energy required to drive the piezo actuator. The fluid control valve (3) comprises the piezo actuator (31) and a driving circuit (32) connected to the piezo actuator (31). The driving circuit (32) comprises: a flyback transformer (5) having a primary coil (51) connected to a direct current power supply DV and a secondary coil (52) connected to the piezo actuator (31); a charging switch (61) connected to the primary coil (51) and switched from on to off when the piezo actuator (31) is charged; a discharge switch (62) connected to the secondary coil (52) and switched from off to on when the piezo actuator (31) is discharged; and a regenerative condenser (71) which is connected to the primary coil (51) and regenerates electric energy due to the discharge of the piezo actuator (31). GB249470689.title: Flow detection device and method for detecting a flow of liquid
GB249470689.abstract: Various flow detection devices 10, 100 (see all figs) are disclosed for detecting a flow of liquid in a measuring chamber 1. The flow detection devices comprise a flow restricting element 2 and a detecting element 3. The flow restricting element 2 is operatively coupled to an inner surface of the measuring chamber 1 and configured to apply a reset force against the flow of liquid. The detecting element 3 senses the flow restricting element 2. The flow restricting element 2 may be a foil hinged flap. The hinged flap may be injection molded to at least one part of the inner surface of the measuring chamber. The flow restricting element may comprise a reset spring 22 and at least one stopper 23. The flow restricting element may comprise a duckbill check valve 4 comprising a deforming snout part 41. The detecting element 3 may be an optical detection element comprising a transmitting member 31, 32, a light barrier beam 31 for sensing the movement of the flow restricting element, and a receiving member 33. The flow restricting element may comprise a flag member 21A. The snout 41 of the flow restricting element may cause a lensing effect, figs 8A, 8B. The detecting element may alternatively be an electrical detection element and may be at least partially embedded in the flow restricting element 2. The electrical detection element may comprise at least one conductive part 34 and at least one electrode part 35A, 35B, 36A, 36B for detecting capacitance. Alternatively the electrical detection element may be a resistance strain gauge 37A, 37B, a foil piezo element 38A or a piezo resistive foil 38B. A method of qualitative detecting a flow of liquid is claimed comprising comparing movement of the flow restricting element 2 with a threshold. A method for quantitative detecting a flow measurement is claimed. The method comprises assessing the amplitude of the movement of the flow restricting element proportionally to the flow of the liquid and calibrating the amplitude of the movement of the flow restricting element. The flow detection devices may be used to detect flow of liquid in a pipettor for controlling rinsing processes.

JP275577737.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a valve type nozzle causing no liquid leakage from a discharge port even when impression voltage to a piezo-element becomes 0. SOLUTION: A valve type nozzle 1 controls discharge of liquid by opening-closing a discharge port 2 for discharging the liquid by a valve element 7 movably formed by impressing prescribed voltage on a piezo-element 5, and when impressing the prescribed voltage EV on the piezo-element 5 by providing a movable mechanism 8 between the piezo-element 5 and the valve element 7, the liquid 11 is discharged when the movable mechanism 8 moves the valve element 7 in the direction for opening the discharge port 2 when the piezo-element 5 extends. When eliminating an impression of voltage to the piezo-element 5, the discharge of the liquid 11 is checked when the valve element 7 blocks up the discharge port 2 when the movable mechanism 8 is restored to a prototype. IN367110290.title: Smart and Self Reliant Two Wheelers
IN367110290.abstract: Two wheeler automotive is one of the most convenient and look-after automotive of the majority of population in our country.Being a budgetable and easy to operate locomotive, the popularity of two wheelers is at a peak in our nation and is an integral part of day to day journey and activities.The usage is not only limited to short rides, but even used for long distant journey too.The major challenge faced is in the safe guard of the vehicle.It could be easily theft or damaged. Accidents in two wheelers are also increasing day by day. Once if it is theft it is really impossible to track its location too.Our aim is to design an innovative model which could solve this dilemma.We propose a novel method which uses a fingerprint control to put the vehicle in motion. All previous work related to security using fingerprint biometric acts upon ignition system. However, this security measure can be easily breached. It requires less effort to start the vehicle by directly manipulating the ignition wires kept behind the steering. Therefore rather than securing ignition, we have introduced a security measure that will only permit fingerprint authenticated users to put the vehicle in motion. The Fingerprint authentication is performed by the Fingerprint Module R307 sensor.The entire functioning of the system can be formulated into two categories, either actuated by the voice command module or by the fingerprint module. As stated earlier the fingerprint module will check for the response of the user. If the correct fingerprint is read, the engine ignition and pneumatic lock release will take place, in case if it fails, the same will be terminated.The fingerprint and voice control module are also responsible for the functioning of release and jamming of the pneumatic breaking system. The pneumatic breaking system is controlled by a solenoid switch which is normally closed, means no power is required for the closing of the valve and in turn the system will be normally in the closed condition. As a result the front wheels will be jammed and for the release of the same, we need to unlock the system, for which we have to make the solenoid on. When the engine is on and the fingerprint is recognized, or when the engine is on and the voice command is properly reached, the solenoid valve is set on and the breaks are released. This makes the system more efficient and prevent from theft of the two wheelers.Another intelligent system incorporated to the two wheelers is the smart system for accident prevention and monitoring. The proper distance between the vehicle at the rear and front is measure with the help of and efficient IR sensor (E18D80Nk) and the exact position is traced. This helps in the controller to act as a speed governor on approaching the vehicle thereby preventing the chance of accident. The speed of the vehicle in real time is sent to the cloud storage reported by our admin at the company through Internet of things principle accomplished using the ESP8266 WiFi module installed in the controller unit.In case of an accident, the vehicle has piezo-electric and accelerometer sensors installed which can accurately measure the intensity of the accident and thereby send a live realistic data to thecloud, where our admin from the company could monitor the data and send an exact alert message to the relatives and saved numbers of the vehicle owner or subject. This data includes the live location of the passenger, intensity of accident and also the emergency requirement. This is accomplished with the help of the GPS module in the two wheelers. Lastly, there is an emergency SOS button attached in the handle bar which can be used by the user in case of an emergency or threat. The triggering of SOS button prompts our admin to get the rela time data of the user such as his voice, video, location details and other technical data related to his vehicle read from the sensor, and with this an immediate assistance could be provided from the company side. With these specifications, Rakshak makes the two wheelers Smart and Self-reliant. We could easily install the module as the installation does not require much modifications to the vehicle and thereby we can ensure a smarter and safer journey throughout

WO2018219755.title: METHOD FOR OPERATING A COMMON RAIL INJECTION SYSTEM AND COMMON RAIL INJECTION SYSTEM
WO2018219755.abstract: The invention relates to a method for operating a common rail injection system and a common rail injection system. In the method according to the invention, after charging the piezo actuator in order to generate at least one injection pulse, the piezo actuator is recharged in order to bring the piezo actuator into contact with the servo valve of the injection system. In order to do so, a measurement pulse in the form of a sequence of identical short individual pulses is generated. As a result, there is no influence from noise as a consequence of piezo oscillations, because the same phase relationship is maintained for each pulse between the measurement position and the start of the charging of the detection pulse. A particularly high signal to noise ratio can thus be generated according to the invention. The invention further relates to a common rail injection system, the control unit of which is designed to carry out said method.

JP274587923.title: COMPACT PNEUMATIC POWER DEVICE
JP274587923.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a compact pneumatic power device which combines a compact fluid controller and a compact valve unit to remedy a defect of a conventional technique. SOLUTION: A compact pneumatic power device includes a compact fluid controller and a compact valve unit. The compact fluid controller has layers of a gas introduction plate, a resonance piece, a piezo actuator and a gas collection plate with a first chamber formed in a gap between the resonance piece and the piezo actuator. When the piezo actuator is driven, gas is continuously introduced into the first chamber through the gas introduction plate and the resonance piece and continuously pushed out of the compact fluid controller with a pressure gradient flow passage formed in the first chamber. The compact valve unit has the layers of a valve piece and an exit plate. When the gas is introduced into the compact valve unit from the compact fluid controller, a valve hole of the valve piece is opened or closed in accordance with motion of the gas in a single flow direction to release or accumulate pressure. CH228005910.abstract: Es wird ein Verfahren zur Herstellung von Piezobiegewandlern vorgeschlagen, wobei die Piezobiegewandler jeweils zwei durch einen Trennschlitz (30) voneinander getrennte, parallel zueinander angeordnete Lamellen aufweisen, die sich jeweils von einem freien Lamellenende bis zu einem Endstandsbereich (25) erstrecken, an dem die beiden Lamellen miteinander verbunden sind, wobei der Trennschlitz (30) mit einem Endstands-Schlitzende im Endstandsbereich (25) endet, wobei das Verfahren nach folgenden Schritten abläuft: Einbringen des jeweiligen Trennschlitzes (30) zwischen zwei einander zugeordneten Lamellen-Ausgangsstrukturen derart, dass er sich bis zum den freien Lamellenenden zugewandten vorderen Öffnungsbereich der Öffnung über die gesamte in Dickenrichtung des Piezo-Nutzens (11) verlaufende Öffnungslänge der Öffnung erstreckt. Vereinzeln des mit Trennschlitzen (30) versehenen Piezo-Nutzens (11) mittels eines Vereinzelungswerkzeugs zu Piezo-Biegewandlern.

KR407017.title: PIEZO VALVE
KR407017.abstract: PURPOSE: A piezo valve is provided to secure the large displacement movement by having plural piezo flexural transducers. The device for regulating the supply of gas can be used in gas-operated heating devices or in kitchen technology.

CN235628109.abstract: A method for operating a diesel common-rail piezo-operated servo injector, and a motor vehicle, are described. In the method, the provided piezo actuator is actuated as a sensor in order to measure the force exerted on the servo valve. Here, for every operating point, the correct charge quantity for the piezo actuator is determined in order that said piezo actuator produces the force contact withthe servo valve such as is required for the force measurement, without influencing the injection process itself by opening the servo valve. This is realized by means of a combination of two method variants, specifically a partial charging of the piezo actuator and a partial discharging thereof. The corresponding piezo voltage is measured using both methods, and the results are compared with one another. GB210604276.title: Method of controlling a fuel injector
GB210604276.abstract: Disclosed is a method of controlling a fuel injector. A fuel injector includes a valve having an electrically operated actuator, such as a solenoid actuator or piezo-electric actuator, which is used to move a valve needle. The needle is moved away from a valve seat on application of an activation signal so as to open the valve to dispense fuel. The activation signal has a profile which includes at least one actuation pulse which moves and/or holds the needle in a valve open position and at least one subsequent braking pulse adapted to slow the needle on subsequent closing of the valve. The method comprises the steps of detecting whether a valve re-opening event occurs during an operational cycle of the valve and changing an inter-pulse delay between the end of the activation pulse and the start of the braking pulse for subsequent operational cycles if a re-opening event occurs. A re-opening event is determined by integrating the current or voltage signal across the actuator over a time window and determining if re-opening has occurred if the integrated signal is at or below a threshold value. The method prevents unwanted re-opening of a valve during valve closure which arise from pressure fluctuations in the fuel supplied to the injector whilst providing controlled deceleration of the needle during closure of the valve to prevent noise and minimise wear of the valve.

WO2017186396.abstract: A method for operating a piezo-actuator as a sensor in a piezo-operated injector is described, in which the air gap between a piezo-actuator and a servo valve is removed by partially charging the piezo-actuator. A measurement pulse is generated at a position at which the usable signal to be measured is expected. A reference pulse which corresponds to the measurement pulse is then generated in the same cycle. A voltage signal difference which is used as a usable signal for measuring the force of the piezo-actuator operating as a sensor is obtained by subtracting the actuator voltage measured during the reference pulse from the actuator voltage measured during the measurement pulse. A motor vehicle having a control unit which is designed to carry out such a method is also stated.

WO2017182195.title: METHOD FOR OPERATING A DIESEL COMMON-RAIL PIEZO-OPERATED SERVO INJECTOR, AND MOTOR VEHICLE
WO2017182195.abstract: A method for operating a diesel common-rail piezo-operated servo injector, and a motor vehicle, are described. In the method, the provided piezo actuator is actuated as a sensor in order to measure the force exerted on the servo valve. Here, for every operating point, the correct charge quantity for the piezo actuator is determined in order that said piezo actuator produces the force contact with the servo valve such as is required for the force measurement, without influencing the injection process itself by opening the servo valve. This is realized by means of a combination of two method variants, specifically a partial charging of the piezo actuator and a partial discharging thereof. The corresponding piezo voltage is measured using both methods, and the results are compared with one another. In the case of sufficient correlation, the second method is implemented in ranges in which the first method cannot be implemented. In the case of insufficient correlation, the second method is not implemented. In this way, the sensor operating range of a piezo actuator is expanded. An associated control unit is configured for carrying out a method of said type.

WO2017178140.title: METHOD FOR ASCERTAINING THE SERVO VALVE CLOSING TIME IN PIEZO-DRIVEN INJECTORS, AND FUEL INJECTION SYSTEM
WO2017178140.abstract: The invention relates to a method for ascertaining the servo valve closing time in piezo-driven injectors and to a fuel injection system. In the method, a piezo actuator is used as a sensor after the discharge phase of the piezo actuator has stopped and the voltage profile at the piezo actuator is detected. In the process, the voltage increase at the end of the discharge phase is evaluated by comparing the corresponding feedback signal at the piezo actuator with a target value. The discharge time of the piezo actuator is varied until the feedback signal corresponds to the target value in order to obtain an optimized discharge time in this manner. The servo valve closing time is then defined as the derived value of the optimized discharge time. The fuel injection system comprises a control unit which is designed to carry out the aforementioned method.

EP203276257.title: PIEZO COMMON RAIL INJECTOR WITH HYDRAULIC CLEARANCE COMPENSATION INTEGRATED INTO THE SERVO VALVE
EP203276257.abstract: The invention relates to an injection valve with servo valve control for injecting fuel into the combustion chamber of an internal combustion engine, having an injector element (100) with an injection nozzle, which has a nozzle module (110) with a nozzle element (120) and a nozzle needle (130). The nozzle module (110) is arranged in the lower injector element (100) face facing the combustion chamber, and the nozzle needle (130) corresponds to a nozzle spring (140) which is arranged so as to exert a closing force onto the nozzle needle (130). The injection valve additionally has a high-pressure line (210) which has a connection to the high-pressure fuel system at one location and is connected to a control chamber (250) via an inlet throttle (230) at another location, said control chamber (250) being connected to the valve chamber (300) via an outlet throttle (270). A valve element (310) is arranged in the valve chamber (300), and the valve element (310) interacts with a valve spring (330) such that the valve spring (330) pushes the valve element (310) away from the throttle plate (290) such that a gap (340) remains between the valve element (310) and the throttle plate (290). The valve element (310) is additionally connected to a valve pin (350) which is connected to an actuator (400) that is biased by a shaft spring (450) such that the valve pin (350) is fitted into the valve element (310) with very little clearance such that a sealing gap (360) is formed between the valve pin (350) and the valve element (310), and the valve element (310) has bores (370) which connect the valve chamber (300) to the sealing gap (360). Additionally, the lower end of the valve pin (350) is not completely connected to the valve element (310) such that a coupling volume (380) is formed between the valve pin (350) and the valve element (310), said coupling volume being connected to the valve chamber (300) via the sealing gap (360) and the bores (370). The sealing gap (360) is dimensioned small enough that a fluidic connection is produced between the coupling volume (380) and the valve chamber (300) and practically no fluids can be exchanged between the coupling volume (380) and the valve chamber (300) during the short time of the valve actuation such that the coupling volume (380) practically does not change during this time.

US406482019.title: Method, program product and computer for estimating the static flow rate of a piezoelectric injector
US406482019.abstract: Disclosed is a method for determining a static flow rate of a piezo-electric injector of an injection system. The piezo-electric injector includes a needle and a piezo-electric actuator designed to control a valve of the injector. The injection system includes an electric generator designed to send electric current pulses to the piezo-electric actuator of the injector, and a voltage sensor designed to measure voltage values at the terminals of the piezo-electric actuator. The method includes the following steps: sending during a phase of closure of the needle of an electric current pulse such that the piezo-electric actuator is positioned in contact with the valve, without giving rise to the opening thereof; measurement of a plurality of voltage values of the piezo-electric actuator; and determining a static flow rate of the piezo-electric injector on the basis of a plurality of voltage values measured of the piezo-electric actuator.

The injection system includes a fuel pressure sensor and an electrical generator transmitting electric current pulses to each actuator. When the accelerator is released, a first electrical command allows determination of a moment of opening of the respective servo valve without triggering an injection. A second electrical command triggers a discharge of fuel from the fuel supply rail to the tank and therefore to discharge the pressure of the supply rail without triggering an injection. The second electrical command charges the piezo-electric actuator between a first voltage level that opens the servo valve, and a second voltage level triggering an injection.

US203769742.title: Visualization of tests on globe-type valves using phased array sequence scanning
US203769742.abstract: A computer with a proper program generates a phased array sequence of signals. In a pulser with delays, the signals are fed through a multiplexor into multiple water wedges that are attached to a globe valve being tested. For a sequential operation of the globe valves from the open to the closed position, ultrasonic signals are transmitted through the fluid contained in the valve and reflected back through piezo-electric crystals to the multiplexor. By summation and merger of the signals, an image can be developed of the operation of the globe valve to determine if the globe valve is operating properly. By comparing the signals received with a known standard for that globe valve, proper operation, or lack thereof, of the globe valve under test can be determined. Separation of the valve stem from the globe can also be measured.

WO2020193795.title: DETERMINING A DRIFT IN THE FUEL STATIC FLOW RATE OF A PIEZOELECTRIC INJECTOR OF A MOTOR VEHICLE HEAT ENGINE
WO2020193795.abstract: Disclosed is a method for determining a drift in the fuel static flow rate of a piezoelectric injector of a motor vehicle heat engine. The method relies on measurements of the fluid pressure performed in the supply chamber of the injectors in order to calculate a measured static flow rate value. This value is compared with a nominal static flow rate in order to determine the possible existence and amplitude of the drift in the static flow rate. In addition, each pressure measurement is performed when the valve of the injector is closed and the injector is open. In this way, the calculation of the measured static flow rate is not influenced by pressure variation effects which are not relevant for the measurement.

KR300175043.title: PRESSURE CONTROL VALVE REGENERATION APPARATUS OF PIEZO INJECTOR FOR DIESEL VEHICLE AND REGENERATION METHOD THEREOF
KR300175043.abstract: The present invention relates to a pressure control valve regeneration apparatus of a piezo injector for a diesel vehicle, which comprises: a guide pin removal portion (20) for removing a guide pin (12) installed through a pressure control valve (10) to regenerate the pressure control valve (10) installed on a hydraulic coupler disassembled from the piezo injector; a polishing portion (30) which polishes a contact surface (13) between a fuel inlet of the pressure control valve (10) and a valve pin (11) by rotating the valve pin (11) in a state where the valve pin (11) is in contact with the fuel inlet of the pressure control valve (10) in order to prevent fuel from leaking by close contact when the fuel inlet of the pressure control valve (10) is opened and closed by the valve pin (11); a cutting portion (40) which cuts upper and lower surfaces of the contact surface (13) so that only a partial area of the contact surface (13) between the fuel inlet of the pressure control valve (10) and the valve pin (11) is in contact, and forms a groove; and a thickness measuring unit (50) which measures the thickness of the pressure control valve (10) after polishing the surface of the pressure control valve (10). Therefore, the pressure control valve (10) of the piezo injector can be precisely regenerated and reused so that precise control of the injection amount of a vehicle can be possible, and there is no need to replace the entire expensive piezo injector. JP275585807.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a piezo injector drive unit which can avoid a malfunction resulting from a variation of a charge operation caused by a variation of a capacity of a piezo injector. SOLUTION: A piezo injector drive unit 2 for driving a piezo injector 1 comprises a drive control part 3, a DC-DC converter 4, a drive part 5 and a capacity detection circuit 6. The capacity detection circuit 6 comprises a calibration capacity 61 for detecting an injector capacity. The drive control part 3 charges the piezo injector 1 and the calibration capacity 61 before a start of an engine, calculates the injector capacity from terminal voltages of the piezo injector and the calibration capacity, and corrects an electric charge threshold from a displacement amount displaced from a standard value. By this constitution, even if the injector capacity is displaced from the standard value, the piezo injector 1 can be accurately drive-controlled, and a valve opening is controlled to an intermediate opening. JP274597498.title: ELECTRIC CONTROL DEVICE
JP274597498.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an electronic control device capable of controlling the driving of a fuel injection valve and the other actuator with high performance while suppressing a size by making a booster circuit common. SOLUTION: A booster circuit 14 is configured by using: a boost switch Ta for boost drive; a pump 4 for driving piezo injectors 51-54; multiple charging capacitors C1 and C2 that are provided for driving a pressure reduction valve 9; and a common coil La for charging/discharging the multiple charging capacitors C1 and C2 by turning on/turning off the boost switch Ta. US203769568.title: Piezo common rail injector with hydraulic clearance compensation integrated into the servo valve
US203769568.abstract: The present disclosure relates to internal combustion engines. The teachings thereof may be embodied in injection valves with servo-valve control for injecting fuel into the combustion chamber. For example, an injection valve may include a valve pin connected to a valve body and an actuator preloaded by an actuator spring. The valve pin is fitted with a very small clearance to form a sealing gap between the valve pin and the valve body which includes bores. The lower end of the valve pin forms a coupling volume between the valve pin and the valve body, connected via the sealing gap and the bores to the valve chamber. The sealing gap provides a fluidic connection between the coupling volume and the valve chamber, but, during the short time of valve actuation, practically no exchange of fluid can take place between coupling volume and valve chamber so that the coupling volume does not substantially change in said short time.

CN204715827.title: Method for determining the closing characteristic of the control valve of a piezo servo injector
CN204715827.abstract: The invention relates to a method for determining the closing characteristic of the control valve of a piezo servo injector of an injection system which has a pressure accumulator. A test charge of the actuator of the piezo servo injector is carried out in order to open the control valve, and an incomplete discharge of the actuator is then carried out up to a remaining partial stroke of the actuator. The gradient of the pressure drop in the pressure accumulator is ascertained during the remaining partial stroke, and the closing characteristic of the control valve is determined from the gradient curve of the pressure drop. In this manner, the actuation of such an injector can be further optimized.
